moments.title: Premier League action continues
moments.blurb: The Premier League season is in full swing, with Matchweek 3 wrapping up today and Matchweek 4 kicking off next weekend, featuring big clashes like Manchester United vs Manchester City.

angles.name: Today's scores
angles.copy: What a weekend in the Premier League! Chelsea edged out Brighton 4-3 and Man Utd beat Ipswich 5-2 in some high-scoring thrillers today. Who was celebrating?

angles.name: Next weekend preview
angles.copy: Eyes already on next weekend's Premier League! Ipswich host Liverpool Friday, Newcastle face Bournemouth Saturday, and Sunday sees Arsenal take on Chelsea. What are your predictions?

angles.name: Manchester Derby
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The first Manchester Derby of the season is just around the corner, as Man Utd host Man City on Sunday, September 13th. Get ready!

moments.title: Summer Transfer Window Closes
moments.blurb: The summer transfer window for the Premier League and other top European leagues slams shut on September 1st, 2026, at 11 PM BST.

angles.name: Deadline Day Approaching
angles.copy: Tick-tock! The summer transfer window closes on Tuesday, September 1st at 11 PM BST. Will your club get those last-minute deals over the line?

angles.name: Biggest Summer Signings
angles.copy: With the transfer window closing Tuesday, what's been the most impactful signing of the summer so far? Any last-minute surprises you're hoping for?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival wraps up
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival 2026 concludes today, August 30th, after a weekend of music from headliners like Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Fallout
angles.copy: That's a wrap on Reading & Leeds 2026! Who caught the action this weekend? What were your highlights, from Charli XCX to Fontaines D.C.?

angles.name: Best of British
angles.copy: For the first time in 25 years, Reading & Leeds featured all British and Irish headliners! A proud moment for UK music as the festival closes today.

moments.title: End Of The Road Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The End Of The Road Festival, known for its curated indie and alternative lineup, takes place from September 3rd to 6th, 2026, at Larmer Tree Gardens in Dorset.

angles.name: Festival vibes incoming
angles.copy: Get ready, Dorset! The End Of The Road Festival begins this Thursday, September 3rd, bringing four days of incredible indie and alternative music to Larmer Tree Gardens. Who's heading down?

moments.title: Lindisfarne Festival this week
moments.blurb: Lindisfarne Festival, a music and arts event in the North East, runs from September 3rd to 5th, 2026.

angles.name: North East festival
angles.copy: North East! Lindisfarne Festival kicks off this Thursday, September 3rd, for three days of music, arts, and good times. Ready for it?

moments.title: British Country Music Festival
moments.blurb: The British Country Music Festival takes over Blackpool's Winter Gardens from September 4th to 6th, 2026, celebrating UK and Irish country songwriters.

angles.name: Yeehaw Blackpool!
angles.copy: Blackpool is about to get a whole lot country! The British Country Music Festival opens its doors this Friday, September 4th, at the Winter Gardens. Who's ready for some homegrown talent?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean still #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for an incredible 23rd week (chart dated Aug 27 - Sep 2, 2026).

angles.name: Chart Reign
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is #1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for a colossal 23rd week! A true modern classic.

angles.name: New entries
angles.copy: Fresh sounds hitting the charts! Sienna Spiro enters at #40 with 'Pure' and Ashe at #38 with 'Stop the Wedding'. Any new favourites for you this week?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing returns
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is set to return with its launch show airing on September 19th, 2026, on BBC One, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Glitterball is back!
angles.copy: Get ready for sequins and salsa! Strictly Come Dancing returns with its launch show on September 19th! New hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are ready to rumba.

angles.name: New Presenters
angles.copy: Exciting changes in the Strictly ballroom! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe step in as the new presenting trio when the show launches on September 19th. What do you think of the new line-up?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is expected to return to Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 29th, 2026, with a new batch of bakers and Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a judge.

angles.name: Bake Off is BACK!
angles.copy: Get your spatulas ready! The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 on September 29th. New judge Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood in the tent!

angles.name: Nigella in the tent
angles.copy: The tent just got a lot more delicious! Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood as a judge on The Great British Bake Off, returning September 29th. Can't wait to see her critiques!

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Monday
moments.blurb: Today, August 30th, is the Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Monday
angles.copy: Happy Summer Bank Holiday Monday to England, Wales, and Northern Ireland! How are you making the most of this last long weekend of summer?

angles.name: End of Summer vibes
angles.copy: The unofficial end of summer is here with the Bank Holiday Monday for much of the UK. What's been your favourite summer memory of 2026?

moments.title: Back to School for many UK pupils
moments.blurb: Most schools in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland are set to welcome pupils back for the autumn term between September 1st and 4th, 2026.

angles.name: School's Out... Soon Back In!
angles.copy: The summer holidays are drawing to a close! Many pupils in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland head back to school this week, between September 1st and 4th. Best of luck!

angles.name: Parents' thoughts
angles.copy: Are you cheering or commiserating? Back to school for thousands of kids across England, Wales & NI this week. Wishing all parents and teachers a smooth return!

moments.title: Happy 37th to Bebe Rexha
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Bebe Rexha, known for hits like 'Meant to Be' and co-writing 'The Monster', celebrates her 37th birthday today.

angles.name: Bebe Rexha turns 37
angles.copy: Happy 37th Birthday to the incredible Bebe Rexha! The powerhouse vocalist behind 'Meant to Be' and 'I'm a Mess' is celebrating today. What's your favourite Bebe track?

moments.title: Happy 81st to Archie Bell
moments.blurb: Legendary R&B and soul singer Archie Bell, famous for 'Tighten Up' with The Drells, celebrates his 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Soul Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Archie Bell of The Drells! Still got that 'Tighten Up' groove.

moments.title: Van Morrison turns 81
moments.blurb: Northern Irish rock and soul icon Van Morrison, known for classics like 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Moondance', celebrates his 81st birthday tomorrow, August 31st.

angles.name: The Man turns 81
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the legendary Van Morrison celebrates his 81st birthday! From 'Brown Eyed Girl' to 'Gloria', his impact is undeniable. What's your favourite Van the Man track?

moments.title: Barry Gibb turns 80
moments.blurb: Sir Barry Gibb, the iconic singer-songwriter and last surviving member of the Bee Gees, celebrates his 80th birthday on September 1st.

angles.name: Bee Gees Legend turns 80
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday for September 1st to the legendary Sir Barry Gibb! From disco anthems to timeless ballads, his voice defined generations. Celebrate with a Bee Gees classic!

moments.title: Gloria Estefan turns 69
moments.blurb: Cuban-American pop superstar Gloria Estefan, known for her global hits with Miami Sound Machine and her solo career, celebrates her 69th birthday on September 1st.

angles.name: Conga Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Get On Your Feet and wish Gloria Estefan a very Happy 69th Birthday for September 1st! The Queen of Latin Pop still bringing the rhythm.

moments.title: Al Jardine turns 84
moments.blurb: Al Jardine, co-founder and guitarist of the legendary Beach Boys, celebrates his 84th birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: Beach Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 84th Birthday to The Beach Boys' co-founder Al Jardine on September 3rd! Let's celebrate with some good vibrations.

moments.title: Steve Jones turns 71
moments.blurb: Steve Jones, the influential guitarist of punk rock pioneers the Sex Pistols, celebrates his 71st birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: Punk Rock Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to Sex Pistols' guitarist Steve Jones on September 3rd! Still causing a 'Pretty Vacant' amount of trouble, we hope!

moments.title: Beyoncé turns 45
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, the 'Queen Bey' of pop and R&B, celebrates her 45th birthday on September 4th.

angles.name: Happy Bey-Day!
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! Wishing the incredible Beyoncé a very Happy 45th Birthday on September 4th. Which era of Beyoncé is your favourite?

moments.title: Mark Ronson turns 51
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning DJ, songwriter, and producer Mark Ronson, known for hits like 'Uptown Funk' and his work with Amy Winehouse, celebrates his 51st birthday on September 4th.

angles.name: Uptown Birthday!
angles.copy: Happy 51st Birthday to the genius producer Mark Ronson on September 4th! From 'Uptown Funk' to his iconic collaborations, his influence is massive.

moments.title: James Bay turns 36
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter James Bay, known for his soulful indie-rock sound and hits like 'Hold Back The River', celebrates his 36th birthday on September 5th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday James Bay
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 36th Birthday to the brilliant James Bay on September 5th! What's your go-to track from the 'Hold Back The River' singer?

moments.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
moments.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday on September 7th.

angles.name: Pretenders Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the rock icon Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders on September 7th! Still 'Brass in Pocket' and rocking on!

moments.title: P!nk turns 47
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning pop-rock superstar P!nk, known for her powerful vocals and acrobatic performances, celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Get The Party Started!
angles.copy: Raise your glass! The incredible P!nk turns 47 on September 8th. What's your favourite hit from this pop-rock icon?

moments.title: Michael Bublé turns 51
moments.blurb: Canadian crooner Michael Bublé, famed for his smooth jazz and pop renditions of classic and original songs, celebrates his 51st birthday on September 9th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Bublé!
angles.copy: Feeling good! Wishing the one and only Michael Bublé a very Happy 51st Birthday on September 9th. Time to put on some smooth jazz.
